final_rationale: The verdict does not change. No new admissible evidence was provided; the Actor expressly offered none and instead narrowed the claim to a qualified, caveated position. That reframing is more accurate than the stronger certification claim, but it does not satisfy the policy predicate in the record. The policy text is specific: rollout controls and post-launch monitoring can mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable. On the available evidence summary, the telecom outage credits segment remains exposed, and the risk-acceptance record is incomplete and unapproved. That means the unresolved compliance condition remains unresolved. A transparently caveated certification packet may be a more defensible description of the situation, but it is not the same as compliance. Because the missing predicate is still missing, the proper final verdict remains noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats.
